description: Job contests with registration still open at public institutions in the city of Iași (not the county) — hospitals, schools, local administration, cultural institutions, research institutes, social care — nearest deadline first. Each result carries `title`, `institution`, `domain` (the employer's kind, not the job's: a hospital's driver is `sanatate`), `url` (the official notice), `postedOn`, `deadline` (the last day to hand in the application dossier; null when the notice states none that could be read — such a row stays listed for two weeks from `postedOn`), `daysLeft` until it (0 = today is the last day), `examDate` (the written test, when known), `posts` (a lower bound) and, when true, `leadership` and `temporary`. `domain` and `closingWithinDays` filter (the latter leaves out rows with no `deadline`); `query` keeps the rows whose title or institution carries any of its words, best match first — pass a job title or an employer's name (`asistent medical`, `spital`), not the question: generic words like `posturi` or `angajări` match almost nothing. `data.truncated` says when the list was cut and `data.matched` counts every match — raise `limit` or narrow the filters to reach the rest. Covers contractual posts from posturi.gov.ro and civil-service recruitment contests from ANFP; promotion contests open only to serving civil servants, teaching posts, police and military posts, and jobs that state-owned companies announce only on their own sites are not included. The list is compiled automatically and may be incomplete, and deadlines and test dates are read from each notice's free text, so the official notice is authoritative. Applications go to the hiring institution, never through iasi.io.
name: find_public_jobs
